objective: Register a bounded report-first local demo UX and independently scoped Tenant Settings administration package over existing server-authoritative APBRA behavior; registration changes no product code.
requirements: Current APBRA-160 owner direction and Confluence 03.07 v26, 03.08 v7, 03.04 v5 and 03.05 v6 control the six-stage Goal → Information → Understanding → Confirm → Build → Report journey, report-first Home, role-aware Administration, truthful progress/errors and categorised Tenant Settings.
Home prioritises current reports and work requiring action, one clear Create report action and direct existing report/history access; it must not become a marketing screen or invent a capability.

Administration navigation separates existing Owner/Admin Tenant Settings, company membership/access and profile controls from report creation. Show only currently implemented destinations and permitted actions; backend access checks remain authoritative.

Tenant Settings sections cover AI and qualified model controls, responses/report standards, budgets/limits, and branding/organisation. Each section has independent draft, Save/Cancel, effective version, validation and actionable errors. A section request contains only that section's deliberate changes; it does not resubmit unrelated AI, budget, branding or credential configuration.

Add a bounded server-authoritative section update operation using expected_version, CSRF and Owner/Admin checks. Reject unknown sections, unknown fields and credential material in the ordinary section payload. The server merges only allowlisted section fields into locked current settings, validates the full typed result, creates immutable version/audit history and preserves protected credential-reference behavior. A stale version fails visibly; never silently overwrite concurrent changes. High-impact changes retain consequence-aware confirmation.

Existing report progress and errors use actual API state, preserve recoverable input/history and show next supported action. No fake percentages, fabricated model/design/candidate results, hidden blockers or widened authority.

The prior PR #98 local/CI compatibility fix does not qualify a real retail report. Paid model retries remain paused under the A$10 total cap; this UX package makes no paid call and does not alter the saved retail CSV/request/history.
Hosting and PR #94 remain paused. No APBRA-167 full theme/Report Studio, ARD, Live Canvas, connected publishing, billing, new provider or unrelated backend capability is implemented.

Owner-approved 2026-10-09 member-branding extension: add only authenticated GET /api/workspace/branding returning exactly version, primary and accent from the active tenant effective branding. Existing resolve_actor and server-derived actor.company_id determine the tenant; no caller-supplied company selector. Only active COMPANY_OWNER, COMPANY_ADMIN and MEMBER actors may read their own tenant branding. No other settings, organisation, naming conventions, provider metadata, credentials, budget, generation, governance or history fields are exposed; existing admin settings and every write permission remain unchanged.
adrs: Existing backend Tenant Settings PUT accepts a full typed document, so it cannot satisfy 03.08 v7 section saves without resubmitting unrelated configuration. Introduce a narrow section update API/service on the existing locked current-version and immutable-history path; do not replace or weaken the existing PUT/restore/credential operations.

Each section draft is based on the effective version opened. A save transmits only that section's deliberate fields plus expected_version; the server applies them to the locked current document and revalidates the complete typed result. Unrelated local drafts and protected credential values are never transmitted. A conflict requires explicit reload/review, not automatic stale overwrite.
Presentation and navigation never authorize report, company, membership, settings or artifact access. Existing server-derived actor and private-resource checks remain intact.
Registration, product implementation, separate independent exact-head review, hosted CI and Haseeb-authorized manual merge are distinct gates.

The finite member-branding projection is a read-only presentation boundary, not member access to Tenant Settings. Reuse resolve_actor and the existing tenant_snapshot/current_settings path without changing authorization modules, schema or persisted settings. Return only version, primary and accent, reject tenant selectors, and retain membership-scoped monotonic frontend version handling. Derived accessible Light/Dark UI colours never replace stored colours or report-generation policy.

acceptance_criteria: Registration changes exactly three governance paths. Product implementation later changes only the seventeen literal API/web/test paths after separate exact-head review, green hosted CI, authorized manual registration merge and verified post-merge main.

Report-first Home clearly resumes saved reports, exposes one supported Create report action and keeps current/historical report state truthful. Company context and current report remain clear on narrow and desktop layouts.

Navigation exposes a separate Administration destination only for current Owner/Admin capability, with Tenant Settings and company/user access distinguished from ordinary report actions. Hiding a destination never substitutes for backend authorization.

Tenant Settings has clear AI, Responses/Report Standards, Budget/Limits and Branding/Organisation sections. Each shows effective saved values, its own dirty state and Save/Cancel. The section request never resubmits unrelated configuration, another unsaved section or protected credential material.

Every section save uses the version opened against; the server locks the current settings, rejects unknown or cross-section fields and credential values, merges only the permitted section, performs full typed cross-section validation and creates immutable audited history. Stale/concurrent conflict never overwrites newer changes. High-impact settings require consequence-aware confirmation.

Actual Understanding/Build/Report progress and failure states use existing API evidence and actionable next steps, without fake percent, simulated AI, hidden errors or successful-candidate claims from a failed attempt.

Existing private report grants, case authorization, Owner/Admin settings authority, CSRF, provider qualification, credential protection, history, confirmation and candidate download controls remain unchanged.
No paid model retry, cloud/hosting action, APBRA-167 full theme, ARD/Live Canvas, billing, connected publishing or production-readiness claim is introduced.

GET /api/workspace/branding exposes exactly version, primary and accent for active Owner/Admin/Member actors of the server-selected tenant. Unauthenticated, missing or inactive membership and company-selection-required requests fail closed. Client company/tenant selectors fail visibly rather than selecting another tenant. Tenant switching and stale responses cannot apply a previous tenant palette. No other settings or credentials are returned; admin settings routes and every write authority remain unchanged. GET leaves saved tenant settings, branding originals, report policy and version/audit history unchanged.
